title: [FLINK-41075][ci] Kill each e2e timeout watchdog when its command ends
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

The PR to make e2e about 5-10 min faster by not doing dummy waiting like https://dev.azure.com/apache-flink/apache-flink/_build/results?buildId=80371&view=logs&j=af184cdd-c6d8-5084-0b69-7e9c67b35f7a&t=0f3adb59-eefa-51c6-2858-3654d9e0749d&l=8060

files.patch:
@@ -998,6 +998,8 @@ internal_run_with_timeout() {
       eval "${on_failure}"
       kill "$command_pid") & watchdog_pid=$!
       echo $watchdog_pid > $TEST_DATA_DIR/job_watchdog.pid
+      # Stop this watchdog when the command ends; job_watchdog.pid only tracks the last one.
+      trap 'kill $watchdog_pid 2>/dev/null' EXIT
       # invoke
       $command
   )
